original_background_call.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production independent action RPG room background, L55 Sunlit Stargate, final dragon chapter.
Primary request: one completely original full room painting, a sunlit pearl ivory high-altitude dragon court, not a flat blueprint. Native 2800x1800 pixels requested, landscape 14:9 aspect, preserve entire composition.
Style: bright hand-painted cartoon fantasy, fine painterly line and material detail, high camera three-quarter oblique overhead near-isometric 2.5D depth, warm daylight, fresh pale lavender star crystal towers, antique golden architectural rings, pale honey shadows, luminous turquoise sky.
Composition: large clean connected pearl stone playing courtyard surrounded by sky/clouds, no dark cosmos. Fixed dry-ground outline in normalized full-frame coordinates CLOCKWISE: (11%,40%), (19%,24%), (36%,18%), (63%,19%), (85%,30%), (90%,58%), (79%,78%), (28%,80%), (13%,65%). These exact outer paving edges must be clear and match those points. A wide continuous central east-west road goes from (18%,52%) through (50%,52%) to (81%,52%); northern broad annex flows into it without disconnected islands or stairs obstructing play. Ground is one convex connected court, spacious for all three hero types; clean little patterned sun-star mosaics and gently worn cream paving.
Scene architecture: elegant ancient pearl white dragon-column buildings and wing-shaped roofs clustered only OUTSIDE the dry ground, soft star-lavender translucent scales on facades, ornate gold rooftop rings. Distinct static entrance terraces at left and right road ends with no gates blocking them. A small tall architectural sun arch at (40%,28%) remains behind north paving edge as a distant decorative landmark. No visible blocking furniture within the court. Plants and tiny crystal flowers only outside paths. The wide empty floor is the main subject, architecture makes readable outer margins, never crowds the road.
Constraints: no people, no monsters, no dragons, no characters, no portals, no star cores or power sources, no chests, no UI, no symbols resembling warnings, no readable writing. Do not draw dynamic gameplay actors. Full frame environment reaches every edge. Avoid photorealism, dark cinematic lighting, extreme perspective, narrow bridges, multiple disconnected islands and room collage.

selected_background_call.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: L55 production room background for action RPG.
Input images: Image 1 is the exact full room edit target; Image 2 is user's world style reference ONLY.
Change only crystal and secondary architectural colors of Image 1: replace lavender/purple crystals and roof inlays with luminous cobalt blue, sapphire blue and sky cyan, matching Image 2's pearl white, polished antique gold, strong sky blue dragon-court identity. Keep subtle brushwork, bright warm sunlight, fresh green edge plants and cloud sea.
CRITICAL preserve Image 1 pixel-relative full framing, perspective, all paving outlines, all railings, complete broad dry-ground floor, columns, small mosaics, bridges, entrances and every object location. No camera move, no zoom, no crop, no remodel. Do not copy Image 2 layout. Preserve blank connected fighting floor. No people, monsters, dragons, portals, star cores, chests, UI or text. No dark cosmos. High-camera three-quarter oblique overhead, 2.5D bright hand-painted cartoon fantasy. Native 2800x1800 requested, same aspect ratio as Image 1.

detail_calls.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: production native high-resolution room detail tile, L55 Sunlit Stargate, for 2560x1440 game rendering.
Input image: exact square crop of an existing original room painting, edit target; NOT a style reference.
Primary request: repaint this EXACT crop at native 1536x1536 square resolution (minimum1254x1254 desired), adding fine hand-painted material detail only. Do not upscale or enlarge the old pixel source; create new native brushwork inside the existing shapes.
CRITICAL invariants: framing, perspective, scale, every paving seam, gold mosaic, blue inlay, cloud edge, railing, crystal silhouette, pillar, leaf, arch, stair and shadow stays at IDENTICAL normalized coordinates, including all four edges. Exact full crop composition and exposure locked; no crop, no zoom, no extension, no camera move, no architecture remodel, no new objects. This tile joins five neighbor tiles using a fixed shared coordinate system.
Style: bright hand-painted cartoon fantasy, high camera three-quarter oblique overhead 2.5D, warm sunlight, pearl ivory, antique gold, luminous cobalt and sapphire blue crystal, fresh plants, airy bright cloud sea. Improve fine stone grain, delicate marble chips, gold engraving and crystal facets. Keep overall colors and contrast matching original precisely.
Avoid: people, monsters, dragons, characters, portals, star cores, chests, UI, text, warnings, grids, dark cosmos, extra props, invented paving pattern, blurry upscale. Square complete image reaches every edge.
Tile identity: top_left.
